events.what: Schnieders proves Barnette graphs with all faces of size at most 8 are Hamiltonian, via a computer-assisted case split of 339,068,624 cases
Bekos, Kaufmann and Pfister improve the subhamiltonian-cycle bound in Barnette graphs from 2n/3 to 5n/6 edges (GD 2025)

judgement.doubts: The face-size-8 case rests on an enormous computer enumeration that the record found no independent re-check of; it is still a case either way, so the status does not depend on it. The Bekos et al. result bounds a different quantity (subhamiltonian cycle edges), not Hamiltonicity, so I treat it as a variant. ProofAtlas lists the problem but has produced no claim, so it is not an event.
